rationale: The reframed account leaves one question: how could leader 4 end without a StopSign after its prepare quorum merged a StopSign-bearing promise and its accepted index rose to 37? sync_log answers it. When the applied log_sync carries a StopSign it stores it and adds one to the accepted index; when it carries none and the node already holds one, it clears the stored StopSign. Any later sync built from a peer whose own log lacks the StopSign therefore erases the marker on a node that had accepted it, which is exactly a StopSign Some -> None transition on leader 4. This update records the clearing branch as a source-backed behavior and links it to the observed end state; it does not claim which particular sync performed the erasure, since the receipt does not record it.

knowledge.assertion: Source-consistent path for the observed end state: leader 4 merged a StopSign-bearing promise and accepted 37, then a later sync carrying no StopSign cleared its stored marker, leaving is_reconfigured None while node 3 kept Some. The receipt does not record which sync performed the erasure.
The observed split: node 3 holds the accepted StopSign at accepted 37 and decided 37, leader 4 holds none at accepted 37 but decided 38.

Shows the marker reached leader 4 through its prepare quorum and its accepted index rose to 37 in round 3, so the later absence must come from a subsequent sync rather than from the promises never carrying it.
Explains the decided index of 38 on a leader whose own log ends at 37: is_chosen counts follower-reported accepted indices.

knowledge.statement: sync_log replaces the local StopSign when the applied log_sync carries one, and when the applied log_sync carries none while the node already has a stored StopSign it clears that StopSign and records a SetStopsign(None) operation. The clearing branch runs for any sync_log caller, so an AcceptSync built from a leader or peer whose log lacks the StopSign erases the marker on a node that had already accepted it, independently of the accepted-index arithmetic.
knowledge.conditions: A node with an accepted StopSign applies a LogSync whose stopsign field is None, through sync_log; no snapshots are involved and the sync's suffix need not be empty.
